name: Pane
text: Pane: A light theme with a dark accent still risks blending into white backgrounds in bright rooms, and the "dark accent" alone won’t fix glare—users will squint at charts outdoors. Test a *dynamic* theme that shifts contrast based on ambient light, and measure task completion time in both settings; if it’s slower than pure dark mode in dim light, the risk outweighs the gain.
